title: Condensation Transition in Entropy-Constrained Probability Spaces
summary: Probability spaces are known to undergo a concentration of measure in high dimensions. In particular, if a $K$-dimensional probability distribution is sampled from a $(K-1)$-dimensional simplex with uniform measure, with high probability its empirical distribution of components is logarithmic. Here, we extend this result to the subset of distributions populating level sets of de simplex defined by a fixed Shannon entropy $H_0$.
